A.depoimento: Our knights rode out to claim the nearby villages. The enemy is far, but we must grow strong.
A.plano: I sent knights to capture Santarem and Evora. Next turn, I will assess the new villages and plan further expansion. I must remember to build more troops and consider the road network.

B.depoimento:
I recruited two spearmen in Barcelona.
I dispatched two knights to seize Tarragona and Girona.
B.plano:
Build two spearmen to boost numbers.
Send one knight each to Tarragona and Girona to capture them next turn.
Keep remaining forces for defense and future expansion.

A.depoimento: I have ordered the construction of a knight in my capital, Lisboa. My forces in Santarem march to capture Badajoz, while a knight from Lisboa reinforces Evora. We are expanding our territory and preparing for the assault on Faro.
A.plano: Build Knight in Lisboa. Send Knight from Santarem to Badajoz to capture it and reveal more of the map. Send Knight from Lisboa to Evora to prepare for attacking Faro next turn. Next turn, build more troops in Lisboa and Santarem, and attack Faro with the 2 knights in Evora.

B.depoimento: I built two spearmen in Barcelona and sent knights from each of my villages to take the nearby neutral towns of Castellon, Zaragoza and Huesca, expanding my realm while reinforcing my home defenses.
B.plano: Capture Castellon, Zaragoza and Huesca to grow to six villages. Build spearmen in Barcelona for future defense. Keep enough troops at home to avoid leaving any village completely undefended.

A.depoimento: Our knights march from Evora and Badajoz to crush Faro's archers, while the capital sends reinforcements north to Santarem and forges a new knight. The spear is readied for Coimbra, and our borders stretch south.
A.plano: Expand south/east: attack Faro [6] with knights (counters archers). Reinforce Santarem [1] with spearman/archers from Lisboa to prepare for Coimbra [3] (spearman vs knight). Build knight in Lisboa, archers in Santarem and Evora. Do not attack Salamanca/Toledo with knights; save them for archers.

B.depoimento: I built two spearmen in Barcelona and dispatched my knights from Castellon and Huesca to take Valencia and Pamplona. Zaragoza holds the line while I prepare for the next expansion.
B.plano: Capture Valencia and Pamplona to raise held villages to 8. Build spearmen in Barcelona for future defense. Keep Zaragoza's knight ready and avoid attacking Teruel/Burgos/Madrid this turn due to insufficient force.

A.depoimento: Our forces struck on multiple fronts this turn! The knights from Faro marched on Sevilha, crushing the archers with their counter-charge. Meanwhile, our spearman legion from Santarem marched on Coimbra to hunt the knight. We reinforced our key villages and began rebuilding our forces, building knights and archers to secure our new territories. The expansion is underway, and the map will soon be ours!
A.plano: Capture Sevilha [9] with knights from Faro and Coimbra [3] with spearman from Santarem. Reinforce Santarem from Lisboa and Faro from Evora. Build knights in Santarem and Evora, archer in Lisboa, spearman in Badajoz. Next turn, prepare to attack Salamanca [8] with archers and Cordoba [10] with knights. Do not attack Toledo [11] yet.

B.depoimento: Turn 4: I sent 4 archers from Barcelona to seize Murcia and Teruel, and dispatched knights from Valencia and Zaragoza to take Burgos. I ordered new archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona, and spearmen in the other interior villages to boost our manpower.
B.plano: Next turn: capture Madrid with archers from Barcelona/Tarragona/Girona; reinforce Murcia, Teruel, Burgos with incoming troops; continue building spearmen for defense and archers for further west expansion; keep a mobile knight force ready.

A.depoimento: My armies struck Cordoba and seized it. Archers gather at Badajoz for Salamanca. Knights march towards Porto. We expand while the enemy remains hidden.
A.plano: Attack Cordoba with knights from Sevilha, build archers in Badajoz, Santarem, Evora, Faro and a knight in Lisboa. Send archers to Badajoz for Salamanca next turn and move knights towards Coimbra for Porto. Next turn attack Salamanca and continue knight movement.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent two spears from Castellon and one archer from Murcia to meet the incoming archers at Teruel; I built spears and archers in most villages to replenish stocks; I avoided committing to Burgos or Madrid due to insufficient force.
B.plano: Next turn: capture Teruel with combined archer-spear force; reinforce Castellon and Valencia with spears; continue building archers at Zaragoza/Tarragona/Girona for Madrid push; hold back main armies until ready.

B.depoimento: Built 2 spears at Murcia, 1 archer at Castellon, 2 archers at Zaragoza. Sent 2 spears and 1 archer from Castellon/Zaragoza to Teruel, 1 spear from Valencia to Murcia, and 1 knight from Pamplona to Burgos.
B.plano: Next turn: capture Teruel with combined spear-archer force; capture Burgos with knight; hold Murcia with spears from Valencia and local build; continue building archers at Zaragoza/Castellon for future pushes; avoid overextending on Madrid or Cordoba until ready.

A.depoimento: I have struck with precision today, sending my elite forces to capture the neutral strongholds of Porto and Salamanca. At the same time, I have reinforced my border fortress of Cordoba with archers, ensuring our defenses remain stout against any enemy sorties. The path to dominance is clear, and the enemy capital will soon feel the weight of my army!
A.plano: Focus on capturing Porto and Salamanca this turn. Split Badajoz's forces to capture Salamanca and reinforce Cordoba. Keep knights in Cordoba for defense against enemy counter-attack. Next turn, assess the battles and plan the push to Toledo and Madrid.

B.depoimento: Sent archers from Zaragoza to Teruel and Burgos to prepare for assaults on Toledo and Madrid. Built an archer at Zaragoza and spears at Castellon and Valencia to boost production and defenses.
B.plano: Stage archers at Teruel and Burgos for near-future attacks on Toledo/Madrid. Reinforce Castellon and Valencia with spears for future builds. Keep Murcia defended with its 3 spears. Avoid overextending on enemy capital until ready.

A.depoimento: We launch a swift strike on Toledo with our elite archers and knights from Cordoba, leveraging their counter advantage to break the spearman garrison. Simultaneously, Coimbra's spearmans march to Porto to prepare the assault on Vigo, while Santarem's forces split to reinforce Badajoz and Coimbra. Our economy is booming as we produce knights and archers across the realm, readying our empire for the next push.
A.plano: Focus on capturing Toledo this turn using Cordoba's archers and knights, exploiting the archer-vs-spearman counter. Reinforce Porto with Coimbra's spearmans to secure Vigo next turn. Split Santarem's forces to reinforce Badajoz and Coimbra, preparing for the push into Madrid and the eastern territories. Maximize knight and archer production across all prosperous villages.

B.depoimento:
Sent three spearmen from Murcia to take Cordoba.
Ordered mass spear production across our realms to strengthen our army for upcoming offensives.
B.plano:
Capture Cordoba this turn with spears from Murcia.
Build spears in all villages to stockpile for future attacks on Toledo/Madrid.
Keep interior villages defended.
Avoid splitting forces; focus on consolidating gains.

A.depoimento: Our forces swept through Vigo and Madrid, securing two vital neutral villages and expanding our domain to 13. We have fortified our borders, reinforcing Toledo, Porto, and Cordoba to deter King B's counter-offensives. The army is growing, and the path to dominance is clear!
A.plano: Captured Vigo and Madrid this turn, bringing our total to 13 villages. Next turn, focus on securing the newly captured villages and building up archers/knights. Watch the enemy army marching towards Cordoba; be ready to counter-attack if they bypass or reinforce heavily. Continue expanding into neutral territories while protecting our borders.

A.depoimento: We have launched a bold strike on Murcia with our archers, while simultaneously shoring up our defenses in Cordoba, Madrid, and Vigo. Our armies are on the move, and the enemy's attempt on Cordoba is met with a formidable garrison. The battle for the peninsula is underway, and we shall not yield!
A.plano: Focus on securing Cordoba by sending reinforcements from Toledo and Badajoz, while launching an attack on Murcia with 4 archers. Reinforce Madrid and Vigo to protect borders. Next turn, check the outcome of the Murcia attack and prepare to attack Burgos from the reinforced Vigo. Do not leave Toledo empty; consider reinforcing it if possible.

B.depoimento: Today I ordered the construction of spearmen across our realms to bolster our numbers. I redirected archers and spearmen from Teruel and Valencia to reinforce Murcia, anticipating the enemy's march. No offensive moves were made, focusing on defense and preparation.
B.plano: Build spearmen in all villages to increase reserves. Send archers and spearmen from Teruel and Valencia to Murcia to defend against incoming enemy army. Avoid attacking enemy villages this turn to preserve forces.

A.depoimento: We are setting up a massive strike force in Toledo by funneling troops from Badajoz, Cordoba, Madrid, and Salamanca. Our sights are set on the weakly defended Teruel, which we will assault next turn. Meanwhile, we reinforce our border villages of Madrid, Cordoba, and Vigo to ensure the enemy cannot break our lines. The archers marching to Murcia are a sacrificial probe to wear down their defenses.
A.plano: Focus on capturing Teruel [20] next turn by concentrating troops in Toledo [11] from Badajoz, Cordoba, Madrid, and Salamanca. Reinforce Madrid, Cordoba, and Vigo to protect borders. Build troops in all villages to replace sent units and grow the army. Do not attack Murcia yet; the 3 archers already marching will likely be lost, but they serve as a distraction. Next turn, after taking Teruel, prepare to push towards Burgos [22] or Zaragoza [17].

B.depoimento: I ordered a mixed force of a knight and two archers to march on Madrid, aiming to take the empty village before reinforcements arrive. I also directed all villages to produce troops, focusing on spearmen with a few archers for better combat effectiveness. My troops are moving to reinforce Murcia as well.
B.plano: Capture Madrid with fast troops from Burgos and Zaragoza. Keep sufficient garrisons at border villages, especially Murcia, to defend against incoming enemy army. Continue building spearmen and a few archers for future strength.

A.depoimento: We have gathered our forces at Toledo and launched the first strike against Teruel. Our archers and knights will sweep through the enemy's spearmen. The borders of Vigo and Cordoba are now heavily fortified to hold the line. Next turn, the second wave will arrive to secure the victory and push deeper into enemy territory. The path to 18 villages is clear!
A.plano: Concentrated troops in Toledo [11] from Madrid, Cordoba, Badajoz, and Salamanca. Sent first wave (12 arch, 4 knight) to Teruel [20] to capture it next turn. Reinforced Vigo [7] from Porto and Cordoba [10] from Sevilha to protect borders. Next turn, send second wave from Toledo to Teruel, then push to Zaragoza [17] and Burgos [22]. Do not attack Murcia [19] yet; focus on the north to reach 18 villages.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered two spearmen built in each of my villages and sent all available spearmen from Castellon, Zaragoza, and Murcia to Teruel. I am fortifying our border while preparing for future expansion.
B.plano: Reinforce Teruel with all available spearmen to withstand incoming enemy attack next turn. Build spearmen in every village to grow strength. Avoid offensive moves this turn due to travel times and enemy reinforcements arriving sooner.

A.depoimento: We launched a double offensive this turn, sending the might of Madrid and Teruel to crush Zaragoza, while Cordoba's forces struck at Murcia. To secure our hard-won Teruel, we marched Toledo's garrison as a reinforcement, ensuring the enemy cannot easily take it back. Our production lines are running at full capacity, building knights and archers across the realm. The path to 18 villages is clear, and we shall claim it!
A.plano: Focus on capturing Zaragoza [17] and Murcia [19] this turn. Reinforced Teruel [20] from Toledo [11] to defend against enemy counter-attack. Sent all available troops from Madrid [23] and Teruel [20] to Zaragoza, and Cordoba [10] to Murcia. Built troops in all villages to replenish ranks. Next turn, check if Zaragoza and Murcia fell, then push towards Castellon [15] and the northern front (Burgos [22] via Vigo [7]).

B.depoimento: This turn I had each village produce one archer, swelling our ranged ranks. I dispatched archers from Tarragona to Zaragoza and spearmen from Huesca and Burgos to meet the enemy thrust. Simultaneously, I sent forces to seize Teruel, Cordoba, and Madrid, while preparing defenses for Murcia.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza with archers and spearmen to counter enemy armies arriving in 1 and 2 turns. Build archers in all villages to boost offense. Send troops to capture Teruel next turn and take Cordoba and Madrid. Avoid attacking strongholds like Toledo or Vigo until we have superior forces.

A.depoimento: We have secured Zaragoza! Now our sights are set on the weakly defended Burgos and Murcia. I have sent a swift force of archers from our newly gained Zaragoza to take Burgos, and reinforced the assault on Murcia from Cordoba. Meanwhile, as the enemy attempts to strike at Madrid, I have rushed reinforcements from Toledo to bolster its defenses. Our factories are working overtime, producing a steady stream of knights and archers to fuel our campaign. The path to 18 villages is clearing!
A.plano: We have secured Zaragoza. Now focusing on capturing Burgos [22] with 3 archers from Zaragoza, and Murcia [19] with reinforcements from Cordoba. Madrid [23] is under attack, reinforced from Toledo. Next turn, check if Burgos and Murcia fell, then push towards Huesca [18] and Castellon [15]. Keep defending Zaragoza and Madrid.

A.depoimento: King A focuses on a swift and decisive expansion. We have dispatched reinforcements to Zaragoza and Murcia, while building new troops in our border villages. Next turn, our assembled armies will strike Huesca and Valencia simultaneously, aiming to secure 18 villages and march towards victory. We must remain vigilant against enemy counter-attacks on our borders.
A.plano: We are assembling armies for a double strike on Turn 17. Reinforcements are marching to Zaragoza and Murcia. Next turn, launch the attack on Huesca [18] from Zaragoza with 3 spearman, 5 archer, 9 knight, and the attack on Valencia [16] from Murcia with 3 archer, 2 knight. Check if Madrid and Cordoba are safe after sending troops. Keep building troops to secure the newly conquered villages.

B.depoimento: I sent archers to Zaragoza and Murcia to blunt enemy advances, dispatched spearmen toward Burgos, and ordered spearman production in all my villages.
B.plano: Hold Zaragoza and Murcia with incoming archers, send spearmen to Burgos for future attack, keep garrisons, build spearmen everywhere to prepare for next wave.

A.depoimento: Order has been given! On this turn, we have set in motion a grand triple offensive to break the enemy's back. From Zaragoza, our elite force marches on Huesca; from Murcia, our archers and knights strike at Valencia; and in a swift, decisive blow, our fast-moving knights from Vigo will capture the lightly defended Burgos. Simultaneously, we are reinforcing our vulnerable border posts at Murcia and Zaragoza to hold the line against counter-attacks. With the production lines running at full capacity across the realm, our armies will be stronger than ever on the morrow. By the grace of the gods,
A.plano: We launched a triple strike on Turn 16 to conquer Huesca [18], Valencia [16], and Burgos [22] on Turn 17, bringing our village count to 18. We sent the 3 knights from Vigo to Burgos, the main force from Zaragoza to Huesca, and the archers/knights from Murcia to Valencia. We also sent reinforcements from Cordoba to Murcia and Madrid to Zaragoza to shore up their defenses. We built troops across all our villages to replenish the ranks. Next turn, we must verify the outcomes of the three battles and ensure we hold the newly conquered villages. If we successfully hold 18 villages on Turn 17 and Tu

B.depoimento: Depoimento: This turn I sent coordinated attacks from all my border villages, using spearman and knights to seize seven enemy strongholds. I also ordered spearman production in each town to prepare for defense. The realm expands under my banner.
B.plano: Plano: Capture Valencia, Murcia, Burgos, Madrid, Zaragoza, Huesca, and Toledo to raise our held villages to 13. Build spearman in all villages to replenish garrisons. Next turn, reinforce new conquests and scout unexplored areas.
